$comment: Maps column labels on the Contact search page to contact record fields parsed from ctr-data-model.md. 'custom' entries describe console-only columns that have no single contact record field; their text is taken from the linked docs page. Verified against a live instance on 2026-10-17.

columns.label: Agent full name
columns.qualifier: the console shows the agent's name from their user record

columns.label: Agent first name
columns.qualifier: the console shows the agent's first name from their user record

columns.label: Agent last name
columns.qualifier: the console shows the agent's last name from their user record

columns.label: Channel subtype
columns.qualifier: stored as the connect:Subtype segment attribute

columns.label: Email subject
columns.qualifier: stored as the connect:EmailSubject segment attribute

columns.label: Contact direction
columns.qualifier: inbound or outbound, derived from the initiation method

custom.name: Contact status
custom.summary: Whether the contact is completed or still in progress.
custom.description:
Whether the contact is completed or still in progress. You can search for both completed and in-progress contacts. For contacts handled by agents, a contact is only marked as completed after the agent has completed After Contact Work (ACW).

The ability to search for in-progress contacts varies by channel: queued callbacks appear once queued; other voice contacts only after they are connected to an agent or disconnected; chats after they are connected to the system, queued, connected to an agent or disconnected; tasks and email as soon as they are initiated.

custom.name: Contact duration
custom.summary: How long the contact lasted, as shown by the Contact search page.
custom.description: How long the contact lasted, as shown by the Contact search page. This is not a field of the contact record itself; the record stores the contact's **InitiationTimestamp** and **DisconnectTimestamp**, and per-segment durations such as **AgentInteractionDuration**, **CustomerHoldDuration** and **AfterContactWorkDuration**.

custom.name: First contact flow
custom.summary: The flow that first handled the contact.
custom.description: The flow that first handled the contact, shown by ID or by name. The Contact search page also lets you filter by the name of the initial flow for the contact.

custom.name: Is transferred out
custom.summary: Whether the contact was transferred out to another agent, queue, or an external number.
custom.description: Indicates whether the contact was transferred out to another agent, queue, or an external number. This option only indicates cold transfers, where the agent disconnected before the contact was transferred. For the date and time (in UTC time) when the transfer was connected, see **TransferCompletedTimestamp** in the contact record.

custom.name: Task template name
custom.summary: The task template used to create a task contact.
custom.description: The task template used to create a task contact. Filtering contacts by task template does not reflect updated templates for in-progress contacts: Contact search shows the original template until the contact terminates.
